name: Nether Earth GS: the boot menu's 64-column print: print64

entries.name: PrintInit
entries.summary: stream 2 opened, the position 0, 0, channel S's output = ChannelOut

entries.name: PrintChar
entries.summary: A drawn at the position, the column advanced (64 = the next row)

entries.name: ScrollRowsUpOld
entries.summary: unused, older layout: B rows moved up; its CALL $815F lands inside PrintInit

entries.name: ScrollRowsDownOld
entries.summary: unused, older layout: rows moved down from row B; the same CALL $815F

entries.name: ScrollRows
entries.summary: A pixel-row groups moved: HL from DE + 32 (the next character row), LineCopy each

entries.name: LineCopy
entries.summary: one character row (8 pixel lines of 32 bytes) from HL to DE, alternating LDI and LDD lines

entries.name: NextRowAddress
entries.summary: HL down one character row (32 bytes; a new third: +8 to H)

entries.name: PreviousRowAddress
entries.summary: HL up one character row

entries.name: CellAddress
entries.summary: HL = the screen address of the position (column >> 1), carry = the column's bit 0

entries.name: DrawHalfChar
entries.summary: A's glyph at the position: a space erases the half cell (EraseHalfChar)

entries.name: EraseHalfChar
entries.summary: the position's half cell cleared (7 pixel lines)

entries.name: InputLine
entries.summary: unused: wait for a key with a blinking cursor at InputPosition, a click, its code in A (the case swapped)

entries.name: CursorXor
entries.summary: the half cell at the position inverted (8 pixel lines)

entries.name: SwapCase
entries.summary: A's letter case swapped (A-Z <-> a-z)

entries.name: TranslateKey
entries.summary: A through KeyTable: the second byte of the pair whose first is A (no end mark: A must be in the table)

entries.name: ChannelOut
entries.summary: channel S's output: 31 and up a glyph, 12 clears the screen, 13 a new line; row 24 scrolls

entries.name: ScrollUp
entries.summary: the screen one character row up (ScrollRows from Screen, 23 rows), row 23 cleared, the row back to 23

entries.name: ClearAll
entries.summary: code 12: bitmap cleared, attributes = ATTR_P, the position 0, 0

entries.name: NewLine
entries.summary: code 13: column 0, the next row

entries.name: PageCounter
entries.summary: unused: counts lines down from the count in the operand (PageCount); at 0 wait for a key (InputLine)

entries.name: PrintInline
entries.summary: unused: the zero-ended string after the CALL printed with RST $10, the return after it

entries.name: PrintStringRst
entries.summary: unused: the zero-ended string at HL with RST $10

entries.name: PrintString64
entries.summary: unused: the zero-ended string at HL with PrintChar

entries.name: ErrorReturn
entries.summary: unused: a BASIC error report A (LD SP,(ERR_SP), the code into ERR_NR)

labels.comment: an even column, an odd code: the font's low nibble moved to the left (high) half

labels.name: DrawEvenLeft
labels.comment: an even column, an even code: the font's high nibble into the left half

labels.name: DrawRightHalf
labels.comment: an odd column: the right (low) half of the screen byte
an odd code: the font's low nibble as it is

labels.name: DrawEvenRight
labels.comment: an even code: the font's high nibble moved to the right half

labels.name: PrintRow
labels.comment: ... and row (0-23); written as one word too

labels.name: KeyTable
labels.comment: (key code, character) pairs: the Symbol Shift codes of the BASIC tokens to ~ | { } [ ] and \
after a glyph or a new line: past row 23?
16 NOPs: room left in the package

labels.name: LeftoverCode
labels.comment: unused code of the package's earlier layout: no set-up before it, a CALL into the font

labels.name: PageCount
labels.comment: the LD A operand: the lines left before the wait

labels.name: RepeatPeriod
labels.comment: the keyboard repeat period the leftover code sets (2)

labels.name: RepeatDelay
labels.comment: the keyboard repeat delay the leftover code sets (14)

labels.name: ClickBorder
labels.comment: the border colour during the click

labels.name: Font
labels.comment: 128 x 8 bytes: two 4-pixel glyphs a byte (codes 0-255), the first byte of each eight unused
